claims: Japan won the 2006 World Baseball Classic by defeating Cuba.
Japan won the 2009 World Baseball Classic by defeating South Korea.
Dominican Republic won the 2013 World Baseball Classic by defeating Puerto Rico.
United States won the 2017 World Baseball Classic by defeating Puerto Rico.
Japan won the 2023 World Baseball Classic by defeating the United States.
Venezuela won the 2026 World Baseball Classic by defeating the United States.
Japan won three of the first five World Baseball Classic tournaments (2006, 2009, 2023).
Japan has 3 World Baseball Classic championships (2006, 2009, 2023).
Dominican Republic has 1 World Baseball Classic championship (2013).
United States has 1 World Baseball Classic championship (2017).
Venezuela has 1 World Baseball Classic championship (2026).
